images.title: Swaminarayan Mandir Kalupur Ahmedabad Gujarat.jpg
images.author: Pk Pratham ( Pratik Patel )
images.description: Shree Swaminarayan Mandir Kalupur is the first Temple of the Swaminarayan Sampraday, a Hindu sect. It is located in Kalupur area of Ahmedabad, the largest city in Gujarat, India. It was built on the instructions of Lord Shree Swaminarayan Bhagwan

images.author: Ramesh lalwani
images.description:
Dalpatram Dahyabhai Travadi (21 January 1820 – 25 March 1898) was a Gujarati language poet during 19th century in India.
This square and atatue was constructed in memory of the poet

images.title: Gujarati breakfast Fafda,Kadhi,Chatni,jalebi-Homemade-Gujarat- pic 01.jpg
images.author: Drmoumitade
images.description: A very typical Gujarati breakfast is Fafda-Jalebi combination. It is a unique blend of sweet, savoury and spicy tastes and is considered as a festive breakfast in traditional Gujarati homes. Fafda is a spicy flat fritters made of besan(gram-flour) or a mixture of rice and pulses powder. They are served with grated raw papaya chatni and sweet and sour kadhi or soup made up with curd and gramflour. This assorted dish is combined with the delectable sweet jalebi or deep fried fermented batter of rice and pulses dipped in thick sugar syrup. This platter is the perfect example of combining strongly opposite flavours like sweet, savoury, spicy, sour and hot into a truly festive treat for the mouth!

images.author: Meena Kadri
images.description: A pair of shoes in the Sindhi tradition from North East Kutch District, Gujarat, India. Approximately 80 years old, for wearing at weddings. Silver wire on leather. From the textile collection of Mr. Wazir, Bhuj.
